svg.title: Max acceleration: how steep the slopes are
svg.desc: Animated, two speed-time graphs drawn left to right together, with the profile's slopes highlighted. Left, with a margin: the dashed profile ramps up and down at a gentle slope, its max acceleration, and the measured speed keeps up. Right, too high: the profile's slopes are very steep; the measured speed cannot climb or fall that fast, so it lags behind, and red gaps show saturation and current spikes. The current limit sets how hard the motor can push, so it sets the real maximum acceleration: measure it (kA tells you), then use a margin. In MAXMotion it is in RPM per second, scaled by the conversion factor.
